Scope is measured, not guessed. Over 4,355 Bash calls in .claude/hooks/hooks.log across
12 active days, the pytest progress lines are 97% of the strippable bytes; git status
and gen-plan-index.py --check together are 3%, and their lines carry filenames rather
than noise. One filter, therefore, not sixty-four.

filters.description: Drop pytest -q progress lines whose every mark is a pass or a skip. A full suite here is 11,282 tests at a measured 1.147 bytes per mark = 12,940 bytes of dots per green run. A line containing F, E, x, X or u does not match this pattern and survives untouched, so a removed line provably carried no failure.
filters.summary: [ck output-filter: pytest-progress] {removed} all-passing progress line(s) removed ({marks} pass/skip markers). Prefix the command with CK_RAW_OUTPUT=1 for raw output.
